title: Step 1a - Hands-On Data Preprocessing for Multiple Linear Regression in Python

cues.en: -: Hello my friends and welcome to this new practical activity on multiple linear regression.
cues.zh: 各位朋友，歡迎來到多元線性迴歸的新實作活動。

cues.en: So in this new section, we're gonna learn together how to build a multiple linear regression model on the same data set that was introduced by Kyrell in the previous lectures.
cues.zh: 這一章一起學習建立多元線性迴歸，使用 Kirill 前面介紹的同一份資料。

cues.en: And just before we start, I just wanna make sure that everyone here is on the same page.
cues.zh: 開始前，先確保大家都準備好了。

cues.en: This is the whole machine learning A to Z folder containing all the codes and data sets.
cues.zh: 這是包含全部程式與資料集的 Machine Learning A-Z 資料夾。

cues.en: And right before this tutorial, I give you again the link to this folder.
cues.zh: 這堂課前面再次提供了連結。

cues.en: So make sure to connect to that link.
cues.zh: 請先打開它。

cues.en: And now we should be all on the same page ready to start this new machine learning model which is of course, in part two regression.
cues.zh: 現在應該都在同一個起點，準備建立新的模型，當然位於 Part 2 Regression。

cues.en: And now we're gonna go of course to multiple linear regression folder.
cues.zh: 再進入 Multiple Linear Regression 資料夾。

cues.en: And we're gonna start with Python to implement this model.
cues.zh: 先用 Python 實作。

cues.en: All right, so this is the data set and this is the Python implementation in ipynb format which you can either open with Google Colaboratory or Jupyter Notebook.
cues.zh: 這是資料集，以及 ipynb 格式的 Python 程式，可以在 Google Colaboratory 或 Jupyter Notebook 開啟。

cues.en: Make sure you also have the folder downloaded on your machine so that you can indeed get these files.
cues.zh: 也請確認已下載整個資料夾，才能取得這些檔案。

cues.en: All right, so before we start the implementation let me just explain again what this data set is about.
cues.zh: 開始實作前，再說明一次資料集內容。

cues.en: So remember, a venture capitalist fund hired you as a data scientist to train a machinery model and actually a multiple linear regression model to
cues.zh: 一家創投基金雇用你當資料科學家，訓練一個模型，這裡是多元線性迴歸，

cues.en: understand the correlations between these features which are the spend in R&D, administration and marketing and as well as the state
cues.zh: 了解研發、行政、行銷支出，以及州別這些特徵，

cues.en: and the profit of what of 50 startups.
cues.zh: 和 50 家新創利潤之間的關係。

cues.en: So in this data set, it's very important to understand that each row corresponds to a certain startup.
cues.zh: 務必理解，每一列都對應一家新創公司。

cues.en: And for each startup, well you data scientists collected the following data R&D spent, administration spent, marketing spent and the state of these startups and of course their profit
cues.zh: 你蒐集了每家公司的研發、行政、行銷支出、所在州，當然還有利潤，

cues.en: because the goal for this VC fund is to figure out in which startup to invest based on these informations.
cues.zh: 因為創投基金想根據這些資訊，決定要投資哪類公司。

cues.en: So these are all informations that we already know from 50 startups.
cues.zh: 這些是已知的 50 家公司資料。

cues.en: And therefore, if you manage to train a machinery model that can understand well these correlations well for the next startup, you'll be able to deploy this model
cues.zh: 如果模型能充分學習這些關係，未來遇到新公司，

cues.en: on these features to predict what sort of profit this new startup might generate.
cues.zh: 就能根據這些特徵，預測它可能產生多少利潤。

cues.en: Okay, so for this fund, you definitely want to build an accurate model.
cues.zh: 所以一定希望替這家基金建立準確的模型。

cues.en: All right, And now we can start the implementation.
cues.zh: 現在可以開始實作。

cues.en: But before we start, I would like you to figure out what are gonna be the first steps of this implementation, you know, before I show it to you.
cues.zh: 不過，在展示之前，我想先請你思考，第一步應該做什麼。

cues.en: All right, So first I hope that the first thing that came to your mind is that indeed the first step is the data pre processing phase.
cues.zh: 希望你第一個想到的是資料前處理。

cues.en: And remember in the data pre processing phase, we start by importing the libraries, that's for sure.
cues.zh: 資料前處理首先要匯入函式庫，這一定需要。

cues.en: Then we're gonna import the data set, that's even more for sure.
cues.zh: 接著匯入資料集，更是必要。

cues.en: And then we will split the data set between the training set and the test set.
cues.zh: 再切分訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: Because indeed we want to train separately our model and evaluate its performance on a separate test set.
cues.zh: 因為要分別訓練模型，再在獨立測試集評估。

cues.en: Okay, so that's always required but then is there something else that we have to do here?
cues.zh: 這些都需要，但還有其他事情要做嗎？

cues.en: Well, to answer this question, let's have a look at the columns one by one, starting with R&D spend.
cues.zh: 要回答，就逐一檢查欄位，先看 R&D Spend。

cues.en: So R&D spend is an numerical column, you know containing numerical values.
cues.zh: 它是數值欄位。

cues.en: And when we scroll down, you know, we can't scroll down because there are only 50 observations corresponding to 50 startups, and we can see that here there is no missing data.
cues.zh: 資料只有 50 筆，對應 50 家新創，可以直接檢查，這裡沒有遺漏值。

cues.en: So all good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: Then second column, the administration spend, you know all the spend in administration like paying employee salaries or anything else.
cues.zh: 第二欄是行政支出，例如員工薪資或其他行政費用。

cues.en: So this column is once again numerical with numerical values and there is once again no missing data.
cues.zh: 同樣是數值欄位，也沒有遺漏值。

cues.en: Perfect. So, so far our three steps of the data repressing template are good.
cues.zh: 很好，目前前處理模板的三個步驟都沒問題。

cues.en: The next one column in marketing spent well same numerical column with no missing data.
cues.zh: 下一個 Marketing Spend，也是沒有遺漏值的數值欄。

cues.en: All good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: And now this column, you know, the last feature.
cues.zh: 現在看最後一個特徵。

cues.en: Notice once again that all the features are in the first columns and the dependent variable which you want to predict in the last column.
cues.zh: 再次注意，特徵都在前面的欄位，要預測的依變數在最後一欄。

cues.en: So back to this state feature.
cues.zh: 回到 State。

cues.en: What reflex do you have in your mind?
cues.zh: 你會立刻想到什麼？

cues.en: Now you should have the reflex if you paid attention to part one data pre processing.
cues.zh: 如果第一部分認真學習，現在應該已經有這種反射動作。

cues.en: Basically the question I'm asking now is do we need to apply a certain tool of our data pre processing toolkit which we built in part one into this data set?
cues.zh: 問題是：需要從第一部分建立的工具箱，取出某個工具來處理這份資料嗎？

cues.en: Well here the answer is obviously yes because indeed this state column is non-numerical.
cues.zh: 答案顯然是需要，因為 State 不是數值。

cues.en: It actually has some categories.
cues.zh: 它包含類別。

cues.en: It has three categories which are New York, California, and Florida.
cues.zh: 共有 New York、California、Florida 三類。

cues.en: And therefore that's exactly the same situation as in parts one data pre-processing.
cues.zh: 和第一部分的情況完全相同。

cues.en: There is no order relationship between these three states New York, California, and Florida.
cues.zh: 三個州之間沒有順序關係。

cues.en: And therefore we will have to apply one hot encoding to that state column.
cues.zh: 所以必須對 State 做獨熱編碼。

cues.en: And therefore we'll have to grab a tool of our data pre processing toolkit.
cues.zh: 要從資料前處理工具箱，取出相應工具。

cues.en: And that's why I prepared it here in order to indeed one hot code that category called variable, the state variable.
cues.zh: 所以我已準備好，稍後用來編碼 State 這個類別變數。

cues.en: Alright, and then the profit is fine, it is numerical.
cues.zh: Profit 沒問題，是數值。

cues.en: And besides there is once again no missing data.
cues.zh: 而且同樣沒有遺漏值。

cues.en: So that's what you know you must do first you need to have a look at your data set.
cues.zh: 所以，首先一定要檢查資料集。

cues.en: If it is not too long, you can check that there is no missing data like we just did.
cues.zh: 如果資料不長，可以像剛才一樣確認沒有遺漏值。

cues.en: If it is too long, then I recommend to apply your data repressing tool that handles missing data and deploy it on this data set.
cues.zh: 如果太長，建議使用處理遺漏資料的工具，套用到資料集。

cues.en: And then you must check if any feature is categorical.
cues.zh: 再檢查是否有任何類別特徵。

cues.en: And here we could check that very easily.
cues.zh: 這裡很容易看出來。

cues.en: The state is categorical.
cues.zh: State 是類別資料。

cues.en: So we're gonna apply our one hot and coding tool of our data repressing toolkit on the state column.
cues.zh: 所以，要用工具箱的獨熱編碼工具處理 State。

cues.en: And then of course we will apply all the rest of the three essential steps of our data pre processing template.
cues.zh: 接著當然繼續前處理模板的其他三項必要步驟。

cues.en: And once again, we will do that in a flashlight because this is a template where we only have one thing to change which is the name of the dataset.
cues.zh: 同樣會很快完成，因為模板只需要改資料集名稱。
